description: Last known AIS position for a vessel: lat/lng, speed, heading, navigation status, and how old the fix is. Use the vessel IMO from get_container_detail. IMPORTANT: an AIS position is a LAST KNOWN fix, not a live feed. Read `position_age_hours` and `position_freshness` (live <6h, recent <24h, stale <72h, outdated >=72h, unknown = no fix time recorded) and state the age when you report the location. Terrestrial AIS cannot see a ship mid-ocean, so an outdated fix is normal and is still useful evidence of where the vessel was — but never present it as where the vessel is now. `position_updated_at` is the time WE last wrote the row and is NOT the fix age; do not use it to answer "how current is this?".
name: get_vessel_position

code.description: On an empty result: NOT_FOUND (no record after asking) or NO_EVENTS (record, nothing filed).

position_fix_at.description: When the position was actually fixed

position_is_stale.description: True means do not quote this as current

message.description: On an empty result: what the emptiness means.

ok.description: False never appears here — failures arrive as tool errors.

result.description: "empty" means the query succeeded and there is nothing to report.
